news.title: Enterprise adoption of coding agents rose to 38%, survey finds
news.snippet: Adoption of AI coding agents reached 38% among large employers this year, up from 21% a year earlier, a Reuters survey of 400 companies shows.

news.title: Coding agents reshape developer tooling budgets
news.snippet: Annual spend on coding agents reached $1.2B, with seats sold on annual contracts averaging $480 per developer per month.

news.title: EU AI Act high-risk obligations take effect in August
news.snippet: Employers using AI to screen or manage workers fall under high-risk obligations from 2 August 2026, including logging and human oversight.

news.title: New agentic coding benchmark published
news.snippet: Researchers evaluated 12 agentic coding systems across 1,040 repository-level tasks; the strongest system completed 41% of tasks unaided.

news.title: Developers still skeptical of agent-generated code
news.snippet: 84% of professional developers use or plan to use AI coding tools, but trust scores for security-sensitive tasks remain low.
